projectState.summary: Current branch codex/byte-connector-color-a is a dirty stacked branch with connector color, sound-preview, starter-musicality, workflow-clarity, song-builder language cleanup, audible voice-led starter integration, keyboard player, foreground song-library pruning, melody-harmony binding, seeded-goal/leadership, tempo-cue correction, llm-song-intent-a, and latest llm-melody-harmony-draft-a. The latest byte adds pure src/song-draft-plan.ts, a bounded eight-bar model sketch grammar: leaders (melody/harmony/answer), modal rootDegree/anchorDegrees 1..7, contour, rhythm, cadence, and tension. The schema forbids pitches, chord names, note durations, event lists, MIDI, lyrics, and scheduling. After a valid song-intent call, Make draft can ask Ollama for a co-draft plan; valid plans persist as starter.draftPlan, render into the existing VoiceLedHarmonyDraft shape, and drive createSongStarterMaterial() through the normal pulse/bass/keyboard/melody paths with song-plan:model tags. Saved songs replay their plan deterministically; Fresh take asks for a new plan when Ollama health is ready, otherwise it drops the old plan for deterministic fallback. Validation: npm run unit:song-draft-plan green 6/6; npm run unit:song-intent green 5/5; npm run unit:song-library green 4/4; npm run unit:song-starter-material green 4/4; npx tsc --noEmit green; focused npm run smoke -- --grep "song library creates|E4 starter generation|song starter applies bounded Ollama song intent and co-draft plan" --workers=1 green 3/3; npm run build green; git diff --check clean.
